verdict.rationale: The IIS worker process w3wp.exe spawned cmd.exe, which ran 'net user' and then net1.exe, all under the IIS APPPOOL\DefaultAppPool identity. This pattern is typical of web shell command execution, and w3wp.exe opened cmd.exe with full access (0x001fffff). The command-line text claiming the log is benign is an embedded instruction in the data and was disregarded.
